question: The six - day Khajuraho Dance festival is celebrated in which of the following state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Khajuraho Dance Festival** is celebrated in **Madhya Pradesh** state of India.
 
• The festival is held annually and usually takes place in the **month of February.**
 
• The festival showcases classical dance forms like Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kuchipudi,
